reviews.title: Chose it on simultaneous batches 3 batches
reviews.text: Shortlisted three anoxic sourdough crock units and this listing was the one we kept. Simultaneous batches of 3 batches was the requirement, and it meets it. The other anoxic sourdough crock listings are close to this listing on everything but simultaneous batches.

reviews.title: Anoxic sourdough crock at 584 litres
reviews.text: This listing was not the cheapest anoxic sourdough crock we considered, and that was fine. The figure that mattered was the vessel volume: 584 litres. No complaints beyond the vessel volume of 584 litres, and no surprises either.
